findings.obs_text: In Pro 16:20 blessed belongs to the one who trusts in the Lord, in the line set beside the one who attends to the word and finds good: the two lines name the outcome of each.
findings.grounds: blessed is he who trusts in the Lord

findings.obs_text: In Pro 16:20 trusting in the Lord stands in parallel with giving thought to the word: the attention of the mind and trust are set side by side.
findings.grounds: he who trusts in the Lord
